# Docker Compose deployment checks
version: '3'

tasks:
  _require-ys:
    internal: true
    preconditions:
      - sh: command -v ys
        msg: |
          ys (YAMLScript) not found. Install:
            macOS:  brew install yamlscript
            other:  curl -s https://yamlscript.org/install | bash
          (https://yamlscript.org)

  check-env:
    desc: "Drift check: docker-compose.yaml ${VAR} references vs .env.example docs"
    deps: [_require-ys]
    dir: deploy/compose
    cmds:
      - ys check-env.ys
===
9:dotenv:
10:  - versions.env

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat taskfile/compose.yml 2>/dev/null | head -120; echo ===; grep -rn "dotenv\|versions.env" Taskfile.yml
